annotation.title_clean: Resolución del Presidente de la República aprobando las Resoluciones N° 595-2024 y 663-2024 de DINACIA (autorización a DRONFIES LABS SAS para transporte aéreo de carga con drones)
annotation.title_en: Presidential Resolution approving DINACIA Resolutions No. 595-2024 and 663-2024 (authorization of DRONFIES LABS SAS for drone cargo air transport)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidente de la República; Ministerio de Defensa Nacional; Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Ministerio de Transporte y Obras Públicas (Uruguay)
annotation.summary_en: Uruguayan presidential resolution (16 April 2026) approving DINACIA Resolutions 595-2024 and 663-2024, which authorize DRONFIES LABS SAS to operate non-regular national cargo air transport with remotely piloted drones delivering medical supplies in urban and rural areas, after a successful feasibility-testing phase.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves DINACIA Resolution 595-2024 and its amendment 663-2024.
Authorizes DRONFIES LABS SAS to run drone delivery of medical supplies on predetermined routes.
Authorization follows a successful technical feasibility trial phase.
Based on favorable technical reports and Junta Nacional de Aeronáutica Civil recommendation.
